body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Toshiba America presented its line-up of eco-products including the company's first LED light bulbs at CES 2010.

Previously available only in Japan, Toshiba's award-winning LED lights last 40 times longer and reduce CO2 emissions by as much as 85 percent, when compared with traditional, incandescent light bulbs. Additionally, all of Toshiba's laptops are EPEAT Gold rated and Energy Star qualified.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
